(Just one new line added: `logs_intake_url = var.logs_intake_url` with a blank line above it for separation.)

## Verification

```
cd /Users/steve.briggs/projects/IAC/terraform/internal-modules/kubernetes/monitoring/datadog-agent

```

Expected: no output (already formatted) or it auto-formats and exits 0.

Do NOT run any git commands. Sir Charles handles git himself.

1. Read main.tf around the templatefile call.
2. Make the edit (add the new line with blank-line separator).
3. Run `terraform fmt main.tf`.
4. Self-review.
5. Report back.
